{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-4-8","id":"msg_011Cdenjs6zpSeWMCmqFfpBW","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The change is complete and correct. Let me summarize.\n\n## Summary\n\n**Bug:** When every action inside a conversions submenu (`copy-as` or `export-as`) was removed from the editor's action set, the submenu trigger stayed visible and clickable, opening onto just the \"Transparent\" background toggle — no usable copy/export actions.\n\n**Root cause:** `TldrawUiMenuActionItem` returns `null` when its action is missing, so removing an action hides its individual menu row. But the submenu trigger in `menu-items.tsx` was rendered unconditionally, and each submenu also always contains the `ToggleTransparentBgMenuItem` (background toggle), which isn't an action item and never disappears. So the submenu kept a child and stayed alive with nothing but the toggle.\n\n**Fix** (`packages/tldraw/src/lib/ui/components/menu-items.tsx`):\n- `CopyAsMenuGroup` now checks the actions map (`copy-as-svg`, `copy-as-png` gated on clipboard support, `copy-as-json` gated on debug mode) and returns `null` when none of its copy actions are available. Each row is also driven by the same flags.\n- Extracted the inline `export-as` submenu into a new `ExportAsMenuGroup` component that applies the same guard for `export-as-svg`/`export-as-png`, and returns `null` when both are removed.\n\n**API/exports:** `ExportAsMenuGroup` is exported from `packages/tldraw/src/index.ts` (mirroring the public `CopyAsMenuGroup`), and `api-report.api.md` is updated — new `ExportAsMenuGroup` entry, and `CopyAsMenuGroup`'s return type is now `JSX.Element | null`.\n\n**Tests** (`packages/tldraw/src/test/ui/ContextMenu.test.tsx`): added two regression tests — one confirming both submenu triggers disappear when all their actions are removed, and one confirming the `export-as` submenu survives when at least one export action remains. Let me summarize.\n\n## Summary\n\n**Bug:** When every action inside a conversions submenu (`copy-as` or `export-as`) was removed from the editor's action set, the submenu trigger stayed visible and clickable, opening onto just the \"Transparent\" background toggle — no usable copy/export actions.\n\n**Root cause:** `TldrawUiMenuActionItem` returns `null` when its action is missing, so removing an action hides its individual menu row. But the submenu trigger in `menu-items.tsx` was rendered unconditionally, and each submenu also always contains the `ToggleTransparentBgMenuItem` (background toggle), which isn't an action item and never disappears. Each row is also driven by the same flags.\n- Extracted the inline `export-as` submenu into a new `ExportAsMenuGroup` component that applies the same guard for `export-as-svg`/`export-as-png`, and returns `null` when both are removed.\n\n**API/exports:** `ExportAsMenuGroup` is exported from `packages/tldraw/src/index.ts` (mirroring the public `CopyAsMenuGroup`), and `api-report.api.md` is updated — new `ExportAsMenuGroup` entry, and `CopyAsMenuGroup`'s return type is now `JSX.Element | null`.\n\n**Tests** (`packages/tldraw/src/test/ui/ContextMenu.test.tsx`): added two regression tests — one confirming both submenu triggers disappear when all their actions are removed, and one confirming the `export-as` submenu survives when at least one export action remains.
